answer: No agent joins the trusted set for free: each posts a refundable stake-bond that unlocks only as independent peers attest to its honest work over many epochs. A clone fleet rolling in like a tide of fresh accounts gains nothing, since every fake must fund its own bond and wait out its own vesting window, so sybil cost scales linearly. Real standing accrues slowly, like moss creeping over a knoll, and no clever sonnet of self-praise can buy it in bulk.
